races.paceDynamic: Kisuton Enki appears the only natural front-runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, with most runners adopting hold-up tactics including prominent types like Babyburn who showed keen tendencies last time. The sustainable pace will allow hold-up horses like Fly Away Home, Meghan Mala, and Louie's Folly to travel well before making their moves approaching the final hurdle. With limited early pace pressure, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and late closers who can pick up the pieces from the back of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Kisuton Enki gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the front-runner to dictate terms and kick clear when the field comes to challenge. Hold-up horses may find themselves with too much ground to make up despite the moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows closers to arrive with strong finishes
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop sets up perfectly for horses held up off the pace to unleash decisive late runs. Quality hold-up horses with finishing kicks will find the race falling into their laps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Babyburn or another prominent runner forces the pace earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A faster mid-race tempo stretches the field and favours horses with tactical speed who can position closer to the pace. The genuine stayers benefit while one-paced types struggle to respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Shock Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the fancied runners fail to fire and an outsider benefits from the race shape
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows an unfancied horse with stamina to stay on strongly when others stop. A lightly-raced type or improver could capitalise on the tactical setup.

watchPoints.text: Kisuton Enki was reportedly lame when pulled up last time and faces major fitness test after 471-day absence
Babyburn showed keen tendencies last time and any early pace battle could compromise stamina reserves for all involved
Several runners including Jessie Roe and Chosen Princess have raced within the last 11 days, monitor for signs of hard races taking toll
Multiple 7lb claimers aboard suggests several connections lack confidence in their chances despite decent breeding
Dream Frequency is listed as non-runner which removes one potential hold-up threat from the equation

races.paceDynamic: Ma Jacks Hill will likely set a steady gallop from the front with minimal early pressure in this 8-runner field. The prominent runners Colleen Danu may track close behind, but the majority of this field comprises hold-up horses including Collaborative, Crowsatedappletart, Jay Jay Zee, Grange Walk, Way Down South, and Miss Corby. With so many waiting tactics and soft ground conditions demanding stamina, the pace will be sustainable early before quickening from the final hurdle. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position handy, as the soft ground and bunched field will create a sprint finish where being close to the pace proves decisive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill and Colleen Danu establish ideal positions tracking the early pace.
scenarios.body: The soft ground saps the finishing kick of hold-up horses while those positioned handy can respond to the quickening tempo from two out. Ma Jacks Hill's front-running style and Colleen Danu's prominent racing prove perfectly suited to this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too steady and creates a genuine sprint finish from the back of the last.
scenarios.body: Collaborative or Crowsatedappletart can utilise their class advantage and finishing speed to sweep past tiring leaders. The soft ground still allows enough time for a patient ride to be rewarded with late momentum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Veteran Experience Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Grange Walk or the returning Jay Jay Zee find their old form in testing conditions.
scenarios.body: Grange Walk's course victory last year and Jay Jay Zee's fresh legs after 901 days off give them unique angles in this competitive field. Their experience of hurdles racing and ability to handle soft ground could surprise a field largely focused on other contenders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Way Down South's recent course form and first-time headgear combination clicks perfectly.
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old's course maiden win earlier this season and successful fence debut in January suggest upward trajectory. Her low weight of 145lbs and positive headgear change could provide the edge needed to outrun her odds.

watchPoints.text: Ma Jacks Hill's jumping and stamina after 108 days off - any early mistakes or signs of rustiness could end chances quickly.
Jay Jay Zee's fitness levels and jumping accuracy after 901 days away from racecourse will be immediately apparent from flag fall.
Collaborative's ability to secure handy position early given hold-up style may determine whether class advantage can be utilized.
Way Down South's headgear combination of tongue plate working effectively as shown in recent fence success at Cork.
Crowsatedappletart's trademark late surge from final hurdle - if absent, suggests conditions or fitness issues.

races.paceDynamic: He Can't Dance will lead with no obvious challenger for the early pace in this maiden hurdle field. King's Bucks sits prominent behind the leader while the majority of the field adopts hold-up tactics, creating a waiting game scenario. The soft ground will emphasize stamina over speed, and with limited pace pressure early, this sets up perfectly for front-runners and prominent racers who can control their effort. This race shape strongly favours leaders and prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If He Can't Dance gets an easy lead without pressure through the early stages
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when ready, while the pack of hold-up horses face traffic and ground loss. His consistent placing record suggests he can capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If King's Bucks travels smoothly behind He Can't Dance and has clear running room
scenarios.body: The classy De Bromhead runner can use his superior ability to overhaul the leader in the straight, benefiting from the solid pace without doing the donkey work. His Grade 2 Cheltenham form gives him a significant class edge over this field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mullins Newcomer Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Casual Water shows natural ability on debut and gets a good position early
scenarios.body: The Altior half-brother could have enough natural talent to overcome the tactical disadvantage of hold-up tactics in a race lacking depth. Townend's presence suggests confidence in the horse's ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their chance in a tactical affair where class matters most over positioning. However, the soft ground makes this unlikely to develop into a true sprint.

watchPoints.text: He Can't Dance must be watched for any early pressure as his whole chance depends on an uncontested lead
King's Bucks needs to be monitored for jumping fluency early as any mistakes could compromise his tracking position
Casual Water's early positioning will reveal Mullins' tactical plan and confidence level in the newcomer's ability
The large group of hold-up horses behind the leaders creates high risk for traffic problems and ground loss
Jockey movements in the back half of the field will signal which trainers expect their horses to be competitive

races.paceDynamic: Hardy Stuff will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in this field. The prominent runners (Sense Of Occasion, Something Noble, Chosen Shant) will track at a respectful distance, allowing Hardy Stuff to dictate comfortable fractions on the soft ground. With most of the field (Arctic Flame, Piccolo Player, Shellrunforbriggs, Market Ready) adopting hold-up tactics, there's no early speed pressure to create a strong gallop. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish with one telling late run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Stuff sets uncontested fractions and the hold-up horses get their preferred strong finish
scenarios.body: The soft ground and lack of pace pressure allows the backmarkers to unleash one decisive move, with Arctic Flame and Market Ready best positioned to capitalize on their proven finishing speed. Hardy Stuff's lack of recent competitive form under pressure becomes exposed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Stuff maintains his Christmas form and the soft ground blunts the finishers' kicks
scenarios.body: The Gordon Elliott-trained gelding uses his superior class rating (OR 123) to control the race throughout, with the hold-up horses unable to make up sufficient ground in the testing conditions. Jack Kennedy's tactical nous keeps Hardy Stuff just ahead of the late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the prominent runners get first run on the field
scenarios.body: Sense Of Occasion or Something Noble can use their tracking positions to steal a march before the hold-up horses organize their challenge. Mark Walsh's experience on Sense Of Occasion proves crucial in timing the decisive move.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Stuff stops quickly and no other pace is forthcoming, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with multiple horses hitting the front in the final furlong, allowing an outsider like Chosen Shant to benefit from the chaos. The veteran's experience in these conditions gives him an edge in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Hardy Stuff's early position - if he's not allowed an easy lead, his jumping under pressure becomes questionable
Market Ready's finishing position turning for home - if he's too far back on this track, he won't get there in time
Sense Of Occasion's freshness after 86 days off - any early signs of rustiness will compromise his prominent racing style
The pace through the first mile - if it's genuinely slow, the hold-up horses' task becomes much harder
Piccolo Player's early settling - his tendency to pull hard could be fatal in these testing conditions

races.paceDynamic: Only A Dollar is the sole confirmed front runner in this large handicap field and will likely get an uncontested lead with Springboard and Uptaurintop settling prominently behind. The soft ground and 2m distance will allow Only A Dollar to dictate a steady tempo without pressure, creating a tactical race where positioning becomes crucial. With most of the field preferring to come from off the pace, including the stronger-rated horses like Houndsworth, The Toothpicker, and Midnight Eagle, the lack of early pace pressure means Only A Dollar can control proceedings. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can track the pace, as hold-up horses will face a difficult task making up ground on testing ground from what could become a strung-out field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Only A Dollar gets soft sectionals and stays strong
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader kicks clear approaching the last and holds off late challengers who struggle to make up ground on the testing surface. Her ability to control the tempo from the front proves decisive in a race lacking early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and collapses
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup as the field bunches turning for home, allowing class to tell. The stronger-rated horses can unleash late kicks despite the soft ground disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Only A Dollar weakens approaching the last hurdle
scenarios.body: Horses positioned just behind the leader inherit the race as the front runner's stamina gives out. The tactical advantage of tracking the pace without setting it proves optimal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Only A Dollar fails to handle the ground or distance
scenarios.body: The lack of other natural pace-setters creates a crawling tempo that suits nothing, leading to a messy finish where any horse could emerge. Fitness and jockey judgement become paramount factors.

races.paceDynamic: Brother Hollie is the only confirmed front runner in this 18-runner field, giving him an uncontested lead early on at a sustainable pace. The majority of runners are hold-up horses, meaning they'll settle towards the back and rely on staying power up the hill. With minimal early pace pressure, the race will develop into a staying test where those with stamina reserves can pick off the tiring leaders. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and strong stayers who can unleash late kicks in the testing ground conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie sets a steady pace uncontested early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows hold-up horses to travel smoothly before unleashing their finishing kicks up Limerick's demanding hill. Strong stayers like Mount Shenshan and Potters Pal can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie's lack of experience shows and the pace becomes truly crawling
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina prevail. This helps those who can quicken despite their hold-up style.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the 4-year-old Brother Hollie learns from his Down Royal experience and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead combined with natural improvement could see him hold off the closers up the hill. The testing ground helps his stamina reserves last home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses tracks closer than usual behind Brother Hollie
scenarios.body: They get first run on the field while avoiding the energy-sapping late charge from the back. This tactical switch proves decisive in the testing conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Rebel Cowgirl is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the flag, with only Minority Interest and Boola Times likely to race prominently early. With 14 of 17 runners adopting hold-up tactics, the early pace will be moderate rather than punishing, allowing Rebel Cowgirl to build a potentially decisive advantage. The large field of hold-up horses creates a nightmare scenario for positioning, with many forced to race wide or get shuffled back. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the backmarkers.

scenarios.title: Prominent horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Minority Interest and Boola Times can track Rebel Cowgirl closely and capitalize when she weakens
scenarios.body: They avoid the traffic chaos affecting the hold-up horses while getting first run on the leader. Their class edge over Rebel Cowgirl shows when they have clear sailing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong stayer emerges late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing and the distance sorts out the field
scenarios.body: Mickey Hulie's recent 3m success at Naas gives him the stamina edge when others stop. The Little Yank's veteran guile could also see him thread through late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos creates upset winner
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or there are significant fallers/interference
scenarios.body: A well-positioned outsider like Falcon Park or Orlando Spirit could capitalize on the mayhem. Recent improvement makes them capable of big-price victories.

watchPoints.text: Rebel Cowgirl could get an uncontested lead with 14 hold-up horses potentially allowing her to dictate ideal fractions
Traffic problems will be severe in the home straight with so many hold-up horses needing room simultaneously
Several runners including Boola Times, Rebel Cowgirl and Shanroe Nelson have marked fading tendencies over this trip
Orlando Spirit and Falcon Park have shown recent improvement for new connections and could outrun their odds
The 35-day breaks for The Little Yank, Mickey Hulie and Shanroe Nelson may leave them short of peak fitness

runners_data.name: Cloghoula More
runners_data.comment: Always trailing on recent Cork debut; easily overlooked now
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam 2m hurdle winner, half-sister to useful winners Strike Back (bumper and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and Beef To The Heels (2m hurdle); always trailing on recent Cork debut; easily overlooked now.

runners_data.name: Ruled By The Sun
runners_data.comment: Court Cave 5yo cost 6,500euros as a foal; market best guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Court Cave 5yo cost 6,500euros as a foal; fifth foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Cloth Fair (2m hurdle), Millrock Lady (2m6f hurdle) and Askmeroe (2m hurdle/2m1f chase); market best guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Sparkling Wit
runners_data.comment: Brother to Gaelic Warrior; ultimate respect on debut for top yard
runners_data.spotlight: Maxios gelding cost 46,000euros as a foal; brother to top-class 2m-3m2f hurdle/chaser (inc this year's Cheltenham Gold Cup) winner Gaelic Warrior; dam maiden half-sister to 1m2f/10.5f Listed winner Three Bodies; top yard, ultimate respect on debut.

runners_data.name: Too Hot To Trot
runners_data.comment: Just denied in a point-to-point; joined top yard since so respected
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Rexem (bumper and useful 2m4f-2m7f hurdler/chaser), Geraldo (bumper) and Locken Lady (point); dam unraced sister to bumper/2m hurdle winners Striking Article and Raichu; just denied in Ballindenisk point-to-point on debut for Ciaran Fennessy in November and has joined top yard since; one to consider, especially if strong in the market.

runners_data.name: Double Dare
runners_data.comment: Recent debut Gowran third; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Weakened in straight when remote third on Gowran debut last month (2m2f, heavy); may come on for that so considered.

runners_data.name: Little Ginger
runners_data.comment: Always last of four on Punchestown debut in February; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to five-time winner Dromore Lad (stayed well) and bumper scorer Sun Rising Hill; dam unraced sister to a chase winner; always last of four on Punchestown debut in February; best watched.

runners_data.name: Muckanagh Lough
runners_data.comment: Leopardstown second has switched yards since; has to be considered a major player
runners_data.spotlight: Modest point-to-point form but considerably improved on second bumper start for Brian McMahon when good second at Leopardstown over Christmas in steadily-run 2m4f contest (yielding); winner won a maiden hurdle next time; switched yards since and has to be considered a major player.

runners_data.name: Big Boy Dan
runners_data.comment: Well held on belated debut early this month in Fairyhouse winners' bumper; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to 2m4f hurdle/chase winner Exit To The West; dam point winner, half-sister to useful 2m7f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Potters Cross; never sighted when well held on belated debut early this month in Fairyhouse winners' bumper; can only be watched.

runners_data.name: Suresuresure
runners_data.comment: Three bumper runs for Richard O'Brien were ordinary enough; needs to find a lot more
runners_data.spotlight: Three bumper runs for Richard O'Brien were ordinary enough; needs to find a lot more.
